args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Summary
args.body:
Source: blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain + companion piece (insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion)

- Temperature excursions in cold-chain logistics fell 30% in 2026 among carriers that shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece notes that pilot programs also cut claims by roughly a quarter.
